content: As of 2026, new projects should install the 'react-router' package directly (currently v8.x) rather than react-router-dom, which is a legacy compatibility mirror that will not exist in future majors and is now pinned behind react-router's v7 line. v8 requires React >=19.2.7, Node >=22.22 for framework mode. For a pure client-side SPA (no SSR), use declarative or data mode, not framework mode. Role-based guards are commonly implemented either as a wrapper component reading an AuthContext (isAuthenticated, role, isLoading) that redirects if the role doesn't match, or via loader functions in data mode. A documented pitfall: guarding only the page/loader is not enough if a route also has an action/mutation -- the mutation must independently re-check authorization, since it can be invoked directly.
